department: Department of Environmental Science and Policy

deadline.value: The department's fall early decision deadline is January 15; the standard deadline is March 15.

gre_general.value: GRE exam scores are not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE exam scores are not required

gre_subject.value: The field has no subject test in these pages.

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to advise the student before full admission.
supervisor.quote: All students must obtain the consent of a faculty member willing to serve as an advisor prior to being fully admitted to the program

funding.value: Admission does not guarantee departmental funding; support comes through posted assistantships and fellowships.
funding.quote: Admission to the Department of Environmental Science and Policy does NOT guarantee departmental funding for master’s or doctoral students

entry_route.value: The department expects an advanced degree; a bachelor's applicant needs exceptional academic and research record.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the PhD program should have an advanced degree (e.g. MA, MS, veterinary, or law) in a relevant field

also.quote: For applicants who apply with a bachelor’s degree or Licentiate (i.e. Licenciatura), they should possess exceptional undergraduate academic and research accomplishments

notes: Climate Dynamics PhD is also offered by the Atmospheric, Oceanic and Earth Sciences department; it is not saved because this field allows one record.
